Board Meeting & Agendas

The Conservancy holds Board meetings as needed, four to six times a year. Agendas are posted ten days prior to the meeting.

Sign up to receive the Conservancy board agenda via email.

Board Meeting Materials

A limited number of copies of meeting materials are available at Conservancy meetings. Board meeting agendas are available online ten days before the meeting.
